```{python}
#| label: fig-stacked-likert
#| fig-alt: "Traffic noise dominance by location"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import soundscapy as sspy

data = sspy.isd.load_demo()

sspy.stacked_likert(data, "traffic_noise", title="Traffic noise dominance")
plt.show()
```
